'''Highest''' is the title of the [[Ajah Heads|Head]] of the [[Red Ajah]]. Pevara notes that the Highest has almost absolute authority over any Red sister and over the [[Sitters]] as well. {{Ref/book|7|32}} She even appears to handpick the Sitters. The Highest's commands are to be obeyed - in fact, she is to be shown the same deference as the [[Amyrlin Seat]] herself. {{Ref/book|7|40}} As such, she holds a vast amount of power not only within her Ajah, but in the entire order of [[Aes Sedai]] itself, the Red Ajah being the largest one. {{Ref/book|bwb}}

==Title holders==
Women who have held this title are as follows:

*[[Tesien Jorhald]] – Not confirmed to be Highest, but she commanded [[Pevara Tazanovni]] to break off relations with [[Seaine Herimon]] when was raised to the Red around 130 years before present day. This seems the kind of typical autocratic behaviour associated with the role, although she may just have been a higher ranking sister.{{Ref/book|7|32}}
*[[Galina Casban]] – Elected Highest in {{Ne|981}}. {{Ref/book|6|prologue}} She was captured at [[Battle of Dumai's Wells]] by the [[Shaido]] [[Aiel]] and presumed dead by the White Tower. {{Ref/book|11|prologue}}
*[[Tsutama Rath]] – Elected Highest to replace Galina Casban. She, along with [[Toveine Gazal]] and [[Lirene Doirellin]], was one of the Red Sitters exiled because of [[the Vileness]] invited back to the Tower by [[Elaida do Avriny a'Roihan]]. Many believed her to have become nervous or bleary-eyed from her years of toiling and hard labor, but in fact she came back more ruthless than ever. Tsutama appears at least somewhat mad to her fellow Reds. {{Ref/book|11|prologue}}
